title: Invalid sign-up attempts consumed the sign-up rate limit
steps: POST /api/auth/register 5× with invalid payloads, then a valid one
actual: 429 Too Many Requests — validation ran after the limiter
fix: Validate the body before rate limiting (src/app/api/auth/register/route.ts)

title: Network rate limit bypassable by spoofing X-Forwarded-For
steps: Send many login attempts each with a different left-most X-Forwarded-For value
expected: Requests from one client share one bucket
actual: Each spoofed value got a fresh bucket
fix: pickClientIp prefers platform headers, else the right-most (proxy-appended) XFF hop (src/server/api.ts)

title: Grammar lesson submission returned HTTP 500
steps: Complete any grammar lesson and submit answers
expected: Score, XP and skill evidence recorded
actual: 500 — Postgres could not infer parameter type for smallint column
fix: Explicit $n::smallint casts (src/app/api/grammar/[slug]/route.ts)

title: Companion unsafe-topic filter missed plural forms
steps: Ask the companion about a blocked topic using a plural noun
actual: Question passed the filter
fix: Broadened BLOCKED pattern to cover plurals/inflections (src/server/ai/companion.ts)

title: Boss battles and kingdoms unlocked on day one
actual: Unlock levels reachable within the first session
fix: Raised unlock levels (content/game.ts, catalog.ts)

title: Parent PIN reset did not clear the child-login lockout
steps: Lock a child out with wrong PINs, parent resets PIN, child logs in
actual: Still 429 until the window expired
fix: resetRateLimit on PIN change (src/app/api/parent/children/[id]/pin)

title: Parent child report and annual journey returned HTTP 500
actual: SQL error from reserved aliases day/month
fix: Renamed aliases (src/server/reports.ts)

title: React hydration mismatches on several child pages
steps: Load /world pages with reduced motion or speech APIs present
actual: Hydration mismatch errors (render-time window checks, random initial state, useReducedMotion branches)
fix: MotionProvider (reducedMotion=user), useMounted hook, roll random values after mount

title: React warning: `ref` used as a regular prop in ChallengePlayer
actual: Console error about ref prop
fix: Renamed prop to refSlug

title: Avatar studio overflowed horizontally at 320px
actual: Preview pushed layout wider than viewport
fix: min-w-0, smaller preview and padding (AvatarStudio.tsx)

title: Blank welcome screen after parent→child hand-off
steps: Parent launches child session from dashboard
actual: Stale RSC payload from client navigation left blank page
fix: Full navigation (window.location.assign) on every identity change

title: Login page layout shift CLS 0.248
actual: Suspense fallback for useSearchParams swapped in the form
fix: Read searchParams on the server and pass initialTab/token props

title: npm audit: critical advisory in the installed Next.js version
actual: Critical Next.js advisory plus zod/postcss/sharp advisories
fix: Upgraded next ^15.5.28, zod ^4.6.7, overrides postcss/sharp; now 0 vulnerabilities

title: No parent password-reset flow
actual: No route existed
fix: /forgot-password, /reset-password, single-use hashed tokens, sessions revoked on reset, no account enumeration

title: Missing master logo rendered as a broken image with wrapping alt text in landing header and hero
actual: Broken image; client onError fired before hydration so fallback never rendered. The UI audit had excluded the logo URL from broken-image checks, masking it.
fix: Root layout passes server-side asset presence to BrandAssetProvider; post-mount naturalWidth check; audit exclusions removed
regression: RSP-public-* broken-image and CON-* network checks

title: Visual baselines captured mid entrance animation (false diffs up to 20%)
actual: Opacity fades still animate under reduced motion
fix: Wait for animations to settle before capture; baselines regenerated

title: Text contrast below WCAG AA (interim wordmark white-on-white, character name labels on speech bubbles, Epic rarity chip)
actual: 1.1:1 (fallback wordmark in white logo containers), 1.77–2.77:1 (LEXI/STORY labels on white), 3.62:1 (Epic chip)
fix: Interim wordmark renders in its own dark badge; character names in dark ink with a colour swatch; lighter Epic tint

title: Progress bars and form controls without accessible names
steps: axe-core on /world, /world/map, /parent/child/[id]; code scan of selects
expected: Every progressbar, input and select has a name
actual: aria-progressbar-name (16 nodes), unlabeled family-challenge inputs (critical), 14 admin/parent selects without labels
fix: Progress gets a default name and aria-valuetext with contextual labels; aria-labels on inputs/selects

title: Landing kingdoms carousel not keyboard-scrollable
actual: axe scrollable-region-focusable
fix: tabIndex=0, role=region, aria-label, visible focus ring

title: Admin analytics overflowed horizontally at 320px and 768px
actual: 51px / 42px overflow (wide table, fixed-width rows, unbreakable objective text in a 5-column grid)
fix: Scrollable table wrapper, min-w-0 grid items, responsive objective grid with overflow-wrap

title: No HSTS header on production builds
actual: Missing
fix: HSTS (2 years, includeSubDomains) when NODE_ENV=production

title: UI audit false results: reduced-motion regex rejected 1e-06s; clipped-control check flagged inputs inside scrollable tables; logo URL excluded from broken-image checks
actual: 4 false failures (reduced motion), 3 false failures (economy table) and one masked real defect (BUG-015)
fix: Numeric duration parse; scroll-container aware clipping; exclusions removed

title: Read-aloud buttons below the WCAG 2.5.8 minimum target size
actual: 'Read to me' 95×20 px; companion 🔊 17×20 px. The audit computed small targets but never asserted them.
fix: Both enlarged to 40 px; TGT-* assertion added to ui-audit

title: Contrast and labelling failures on pages the audit had not scanned (locked items, admin chip, economy inputs)
actual: Locked cards dimmed with whole-card opacity (text 3.1–4.2:1); 'Admin' chip 4.48:1; 80 unlabeled XP/coin/crystal/cap inputs (20 activities × 4; critical)
fix: Only the artwork of locked items is dimmed (dashed border marks them); lighter chip tint; aria-labels on every economy input

title: Accessibility audit covered only 11 of 45 pages and could crash the run
expected: axe on every page; one page failure recorded, not fatal
actual: axe ran on 11 hand-picked pages; a navigation timeout aborted the whole audit
fix: axe and keyboard checks on every public, child, parent and admin page; per-page try/catch records BLOCKED; waits for fades before measuring contrast

title: Typed spelling answer could be wiped right after a new question appeared
steps: In the quest, start typing in a spelling round immediately after pressing Next (reproduced by the browser journey: input filled, then cleared, 'Check' stayed disabled)
actual: Answer state was reset in a useEffect that ran after the new question was painted, clearing anything typed in that window (more likely on slow devices)
fix: Reset answer state during render when the question changes; the effect now only plays the audio (Question.tsx, used by quest, revision and all challenges)

title: API p95 at or above the 1.5s target with 30 concurrent children on embedded PGlite (unstable)
actual: Two production-build runs: p95 2,554 ms (fail) and 1,496 ms (pass by 4 ms); max 8–10 s. 0 errors and correct awards in both. PGlite is single-connection.
fix: Re-test on managed Postgres/Supabase with a connection pool before launch

title: Official master logo file not present in the repository
actual: Interim wordmark shown; favicon/OG derivatives not generated
fix: Commit the original file, run npm run brand:assets

title: Real Claude writing evaluation and companion not tested
actual: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured — offline evaluators verified only
fix: Run qa-api with a staging key
